title: Canonical bounded-constructible scalar comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$, and a compactification $c$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $\mathcal C_H(T)$ and $\mathcal C_\Omega(T)$ for the bounded constructible condensed module-object categories and scalar functors $T^T_{H,H'}$, $T^T_{H,\Omega}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit], with $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ carrying the finite-subextension-valued condensed coefficient ring. Write $P_H$ and $P_\Omega$ for the fixed compact-support composites [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. The data structures and displayed equations are [def-pur-filtered-condensed-representing-pair-data]. There exist comparison isomorphisms $s_{H,H'}:T^Y_{H,H'}P_H\simeq P_{H'}T^X_{H,H'}$ for each finite inclusion, and $s_{H,\Omega}:T^Y_{H,\Omega}P_H\simeq P_\Omega T^X_{H,\Omega}$ for each finite $H$. Under the recorded constructible inclusion isomorphisms their components are exactly the original condensedProjection mates. In Lean this is $\exists s,\ s.\mathrm{IsCanonical}$. No representing pair is assumed or constructed.

proof.text:
for each finite inclusion and each inclusion into the closure, take the original
proper/open projection mate. Its components on bounded constructible objects are
invertible by finiteProjection_isIso and omegaProjection_isIso. Conjugate through the
recorded inclusion compatibility isomorphisms, then lift the resulting transformation
through the fully faithful constructible inclusion. Naturality follows from that of
the projection. Lift its inverse in the same way. Faithfulness proves the inverse
identities and the displayed normalization equations. This uses the finite-valued
closure ring throughout, including for an empty source scheme. If coefficient and scheme universes differ, lift the coefficient field to the scheme universe, transport the coefficient categories and projection mate along that ring equivalence, apply the realization projection theorem there, and transport invertibility back.
